System architecture

Modular by design.

PV, optional wind, battery storage and optional DC charging are connected through project-specific AC, DC or hybrid architectures. A bidirectional power conversion system interfaces with the public grid, while the EMS coordinates energy flows.

A

Battery Housing

Dedicated battery racks, BMS, cooling, protection and fire safety equipment.

B

Power Electronics

PCS, DC/DC conversion where applicable, switchgear, meters, protection and EMS.

C

Flexible Packaging

Separate enclosures or integrated 10/20 ft container concepts, subject to engineering and safety assessment.

Conceptual description only. Final designs depend on applicable grid codes, approvals, component compatibility and safety requirements.

Grow at your own pace

Start smart. Scale when you need to.

Your energy infrastructure should grow with your business. EDISON-G plans modular, expansion-ready solutions so you can match your initial investment to today’s demand while preparing for future capacity.

01

Start with what matters

Deploy a right-sized PV and battery system, for example 250–500 kWh, with mandatory public-grid connection.

02

Expand storage and solar

Add compatible battery capacity and PV generation as energy consumption, operating requirements and economics evolve.

03

Build your energy hub

Integrate optional wind generation, additional power conversion capacity or DC high-power charging where technically feasible.

Expansion options are assessed during initial engineering. Future upgrades depend on space, grid approvals, equipment compatibility, electrical ratings and safety requirements; they are not automatic guarantees.

Modular hardware

Engineered building blocks.

Containerized battery storage, power conversion and charging infrastructure can be configured to suit each location and future expansion plan.

About EDISON-G

Swiss-based. Internationally connected.

EDISON-G AG focuses on tailored energy infrastructure concepts and the integration of selected technologies. Our approach prioritizes system compatibility, verified technical specifications and lifecycle economics.

Certification & safety

Certified to German
safety standards.

The whole product is certified based on the VDE (Verband der Elektrotechnik) standards and licensed by GS (Geprüfte Sicherheit) to ensure that it follows all safety regulations and procedures.
